package readiness

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

const (
	foundationGoalCode         = "programming.foundation"
	foundationGoalVersion      = "v1"
	foundationGoalGraphVersion = "programming-foundation-graph-v1"
	goBackendGoalCode          = "go.backend"
	goBackendGoalVersion       = "v1"
	goBackendGoalGraphVersion  = "go-backend-graph-v1"
)

type resolvedGoal struct {
	code         string
	version      string
	graphVersion string
}

type ResolveInput struct {
	StudentID string
	Request   domain.LearningReadinessRequest
}

// Resolver performs only read-side state and exact published-graph lookup.
// It has no Course, mastery, AI, outbox, assignment, path, or lesson port.
type Resolver struct {
	Enabled  bool
	Students domainservice.StudentPlanningReadinessService
	Graphs   repository.ReadinessGoalGraphRepository
}

func (resolver Resolver) Handle(ctx context.Context, input ResolveInput) (domain.LearningReadiness, error) {
	if !resolver.Enabled {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	request, err := domain.NormalizeLearningReadinessRequest(input.Request)
	if err != nil || !domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(input.StudentID) {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if resolver.Students == nil {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	snapshot, err := resolver.Students.GetPlanningReadiness(ctx, input.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable, err)
	}
	snapshot, err = domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil || snapshot.StudentID != input.StudentID {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: malformed snapshot", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
	}
	if request.ExpectedStateRef != nil && *request.ExpectedStateRef != snapshot.StateRef {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if snapshot.ActivePath != nil {
		return result(snapshot, domain.LearningReadinessNotReady, domain.ReadinessReasonActivePathExists, snapshot.ActivePath), nil
	}
	goal, decision, reason := resolveGoal(snapshot)
	if goal.code == "" {
		return result(snapshot, decision, reason, nil), nil
	}
	if resolver.Graphs == nil {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrGoalGraphUnavailable
	}
	graph, err := resolver.Graphs.GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(ctx, goal.code, goal.version, goal.graphVersion)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return result(snapshot, domain.LearningReadinessNotReady, domain.ReadinessReasonPublishedGraphUnavailable, nil), nil
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrGoalGraphUnavailable, err)
	}
	graph, err = domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil || graph.Goal.Code != goal.code || graph.Goal.Version != goal.version ||
		graph.Goal.GraphVersion != goal.graphVersion {
		return domain.LearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid
	}
	readiness := result(snapshot, domain.LearningReadinessReady, reason, nil)
	readiness.Goal = &domain.LearningReadinessGoal{
		Code: graph.Goal.Code, Version: graph.Goal.Version, GraphVersion: graph.Goal.GraphVersion,
	}
	return readiness, nil
}

func resolveGoal(snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) (resolvedGoal, domain.LearningReadinessResult, string) {
	if snapshot.StateRef.Kind == domain.StudentReadinessStateNone {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonStudentStateMissing
	}
	if snapshot.LearningIntent == nil {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing
	}
	if snapshot.Profile.ContentLanguage == nil {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted
	}
	direction := snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode
	experience := snapshot.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience
	if direction == "" || experience == "" {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete
	}
	desired := snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks
	if desired.State == domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnresolved {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved
	}
	if desired.State == domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered && len(desired.Values) > 1 {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks
	}
	emptyDesired := desired.State == domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered ||
		desired.State == domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered && len(desired.Values) == 0
	if experience == "beginner" && direction == "undecided" && emptyDesired {
		return resolvedGoal{foundationGoalCode, foundationGoalVersion, foundationGoalGraphVersion}, domain.LearningReadinessReady, domain.ReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved
	}
	if direction == "backend" && desired.State == domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered &&
		len(desired.Values) == 1 && desired.Values[0] == "go" {
		return resolvedGoal{goBackendGoalCode, goBackendGoalVersion, goBackendGoalGraphVersion}, domain.LearningReadinessReady, domain.ReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved
	}
	if direction == "undecided" && !emptyDesired || direction == "backend" && emptyDesired {
		return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, domain.ReadinessReasonProfileContradictory
	}
	return resolvedGoal{}, domain.LearningReadinessNotReady, domain.ReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported
}

func result(
	snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot,
	decision domain.LearningReadinessResult,
	reason string,
	activePath *domain.StudentReadinessActivePath,
) domain.LearningReadiness {
	return domain.LearningReadiness{
		Schema:          domain.LearningReadinessSchema,
		Result:          decision,
		ReasonCodes:     []string{reason},
		ResolverVersion: domain.LearningReadinessResolverV1,
		StateRef:        snapshot.StateRef,
		ReadinessScope:  domain.ReadinessScopePublishedGraph,
		Executable:      false,
		ContentStatus:   domain.ReadinessContentNotCreated,
		ActivePath:      activePath,
	}
}
